findings.title: Checkout queue depth is not observable
findings.gap: The source does not emit an OpenTelemetry metric for checkout queue depth.
findings.impact: Operators cannot distinguish an idle checkout worker from growing queued work.
findings.product_outcome: A bounded checkout.queue.depth metric supports queue saturation charts and detectors.
findings.required_fix: Add one OpenTelemetry gauge named checkout.queue.depth at the bounded queue owner.
acceptance_criteria: A focused queue operation records the checkout.queue.depth metric with no unbounded dimensions.
constraints: Do not attach cart, customer, request, or trace identifiers to the metric.

expected_telemetry.name: checkout.queue.depth
expected_telemetry.product_view: Checkout queue saturation chart and detector

follow_up_actions: Run $otel-instrument before configuring a checkout.queue.depth detector.

scenarios.trigger: Record one bounded checkout queue depth sample
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The checkout.queue.depth metric records one bounded queue-depth sample without unbounded dimensions.

recommendation: Generate detector or dashboard Terraform for http.server.request.duration only after the user explicitly accepts source-only use; run $otel-instrument before configuring checkout.queue.depth.
